focusedTestMethod: One real public-import boundary case; other lifecycle cases evaluate the unchanged helper body with test-only public-factory substitution. No production dependency injection option.
independentInternalReview: No remaining release blocker; internal code review, not an external audit.
implemented: Only the captured 1-8 approved payments are selectable; first approved payment is the default.
Explicit credential-free availability precedes authentication; no journal, storage or Web Lock access during construction or availability.
Open consumes a funded observation at most 30 seconds old and starts existing native authentication synchronously before awaiting.
Selection and close invalidate reads and abort native opening; late results cannot install a signer or release a newer operation.
An unfinished native promise blocks a second prompt until it settles; late recovered signing material is closed.
Known uncertainty blocks the whole account across selections; exact fresh journal reconciliation clears only its own known pending right.
Late canceled journal reads can retain a defensive blocker but cannot clear one; if they block a newer active or opening session, it is closed or aborted.
Unscoped account/journal problems remain blocked pending explicit reconciliation; another receipt does not reset them.
Collection uses the selected/opened payment only, prevents selection during sending, and closes the parent signer after every attempt.
Monotonic and absolute deadlines are checked after authentication and before collection, independently of delayed browser timers.
Updated integration instructions render current state and preserve separate check, open, collect and reconciliation actions.
limits: Copyable integration helper and README, not yet a complete generated runnable payment template.
Readiness is advisory and does not prove payment, grant signing authority or scan all journal history before native opening.
Test RPC responses are simulated; actual disposable local Mera signers are used only in the installed consumer.
No new physical browser/device test, native credential use, public payment, third-party integration or customer-demand evidence.
Same-origin journal/locks do not coordinate different devices or origins; recovery still returns full account authority.
Overlapping local and initial replay runs are not summed into the final 51-test count.
